accuracy.detail: Disease classifier near-perfect on v5.1 drift data. Onset model at chance (not needed — disease model detects drift directly).

robustness.detail: v5.1 sigmoid drift eliminates instantaneous artifacts. All disease onset is gradual.

early_detection.detail: 0% at 24h — only 4 test episodes (too few). Model DOES detect during drift window (prob 0→1 within 48h pre-onset). Need larger test cohort.
early_detection.note: Disease prob covers 0-1 range in pre_48h window, confirming drift detection capability.

hybrid_engine.note: Onset model not contributing (AUC=0.5). Disease model alone sufficient for v5.1 data.

improvements_from_v7.note: v5.1 drift data solved simulation artifact problem. Silent onsets eliminated.

remaining_gap.early_detection: Need to increase test episodes (>20 episodes) for statistical reliability.
remaining_gap.onset_model: Onset model adds no value on v5.1 — disease classifier detects drift directly.
remaining_gap.recommendation: Scale to 500+ animals with 20%+ disease rate for production validation.
